quest.title: Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix
quest.description: At Luyang Academy, you encounter a Guhua sword practitioner honing their skills...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #Your technique is truly extraordinary, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, you bet! {NICKNAME}'s the real deal!

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #In that case, I wonder if this {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine} might demonstrate the true essence of <color=#00E1FFFF>Leaping Techniques</color> for me?

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: According to the records, the ancient masters of my sect, the Guhua Clan, could scale city walls as if they were walking on flat ground. Having truly mastered the art of roof-running and wall-scaling, they distilled these skills into the Leaping Techniques.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... We might as well give it a shot. You've done plenty of climbing around looking for treasure anyway, haven't you, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Sounds like cat burglary to me...

response.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
response.text: #Hehe, come to think of it, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}. If a thief can skip over a wall to escape justice, but we who uphold it cannot, wouldn't that leave us powerless to stop the wicked from slipping away?

talks.objective: Talk to the person in the painting

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With a swift leap, the figure from the painting lands right in front of you...

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #Greetings. I'm Zhangsun Jijing. It's an honor to meet you in person, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}. {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, may I ask why you have called out to me? Do you have urgent matters to discuss?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, nothing like that. We just saw you hopping all over the place inside the painting and got a bit curious...

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Ah, I see. I was merely practicing my lightfoot techniques. That said, I'm afraid I've treated you to a rather poor display.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lightfoot techniques?

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Indeed. You see, since rain never falls in this realm, I'm unable to practice the "Rain Cutter" arts passed down by my master. Not wishing to let my skills wither from neglect, I've resorted to training in this manner instead.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: I often think of those bygone days, when the Great Master Guhua honed his agility upon these very stone piles, eventually reaching the pinnacle of his art. We juniors are of meager talent, yet we strive to imitate even a fraction of his brilliance, hoping for the slightest bit of progress.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #{M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, since fate has brought us together today, and seeing as you are a fellow practitioner of martial mastery... might I ask you to enlighten me with your skills?

choices.text: Hmph, just as I'd hoped. Thou shalt witness my skill!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Why are you speaking so weirdly all of a sudden? Anyway, uh, what exactly are we supposed to do?

response.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
response.text: My thanks. In that case, if I may have your attention...

choices.text: Actually, Paimon's the master of our Paimon Clan. Show us your moves, Master!

response.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
response.text: Ah! So I stand before the master of the Paimon Clan, Paimon herself? Forgive my ignorance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Geez. Do you even hear yourself? Also, since when does the master do all the heavy lifting first?

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Have a look at this — our "Plumwatcher Piles," the pride of Guhua.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: May I ask you to step on the stone piles in the order I specify within the allotted time, thus demonstrating your prowess?

choices.text: No problem, it'll be a walk in the park.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though there sure are a lot of "parks" to walk across... Uh, never mind.

response.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
response.text: #Well then, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, it's time to display your prowess.

choices.text: Actually, I bet even Paimon, the master of the Paimon Clan, could pull it off...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? That's impossible, no matter how you... Wait. Paimon probably could... but flying would be cheating, right?

talks.objective: Stand atop the Plumwatcher Piles and show off your moves

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #{M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, are you prepared?

talks.objective: Leap onto the roof to display your skills

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Truly awe-inspiring. I'm deeply impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #That being the case... I have one more humble request. I wonder... Have you, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, heard of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cloud-Striding Techniques</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Rumor has it that our Grandmaster, Guhua, once ascended the heavens amidst a purple haze, treading upon the very air as if it were solid ground — all made possible by none other than this legendary secret art...

choices.text: Sounds a bit far-fetched to me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, sounds like some real hogwash... But come to think of it, could we pull off something similar by using a Wind Glider?

response.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
response.text: Oh? Then might I ask you to show me a thing or two?

choices.text: If we could use the Wind Glider...

talks.objective: Find some way to show off your chops in mid-air

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: Fascinating...

dialogues.speaker: Zhangsun Jijing
dialogues.text: #One could not call that "treading upon air," but you have inspired me all the same. My thanks for your guidance, {M#fine sir}{F#young heroine}.
